app.notes: Use Gonka, working in a folder: the real reason a long file came back as "no file name was given". The service was cutting the answer off in the middle of writing the file, and the half-written call was run as if it were whole. Answers now have room for 8,192 tokens and up to ten minutes to arrive, a cut-off step says so plainly and nothing half-written is ever run, the model is told to write one file per turn, and the working line counts the seconds so a long write no longer looks frozen.
